name: soloist_connect
description: Spotify Connect on Volumio 3 via Spotify Soloist, playing through pcm.volumio (ALSA, no Pulse). Best effort build.
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Best effort build for Volumio 3, offered as-is and tested by the community. Turns Volumio 3 into a Spotify Connect device using Spotify Soloist. Audio goes through pcm.volumio via an in-tree Pulse shim (0.2.9), with no PulseAudio or PipeWire. Requires your own Soloist API key from the Spotify for Developers dashboard. Unofficial and not affiliated with Spotify AB. The Soloist binary is downloaded from Spotify at install time and is not bundled. Installed from the GitHub release, not from the plugin store.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.9.4: With FusionDSP in the chain the sample rate shown is the stream's own, read from the parameters FusionDSP publishes, not CamillaDSP's output rate. 0.9.3: The API key leaves the daemon's command line about two seconds after start, whether or not anything has played. 0.9.2: The Spotify Queue page is a plain read, complete when opened, and is no longer pushed to every connected client.
